mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) as 订单量, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as 营业额, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) as 实收金额, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as 单均价 FROM order_main WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE(NOW()) AND pay_status = 1 AND order_main_id IN ( SELECT order_main_id FROM order_takeout_detail WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantBaseId} )

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) as 订单量, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as 营业额, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) as 实收金额, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as 单均价 FROM order_main WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AND pay_status = 1 AND order_main_id IN ( SELECT order_main_id FROM order_takeout_detail WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantBaseId} )
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) as 综合评分, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) as 评价总数 FROM merchant_evaluation WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId}

SELECT rating as 评分等级, COUNT(*) as 评价数量, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 1) FROM merchant_evaluation WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} ), 2) as 占比百分比 FROM merchant_evaluation WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC

SELECT mg.merchant_goods_id as 商品ID, mg.goods_name as 商品名称, COALESCE(mg.price, 0) as 商品价格, COALESCE(SUM(otd.quantity), 0) as 销售数量, COALESCE(SUM(otd.subtotal), 0) as 销售总额, @rank := @rank + 1 as 排名 FROM order_takeout_detail otd JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id JOIN merchant_goods mg ON otd.goods_id = mg.merchant_goods_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0) r WHERE om.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND om.pay_status = 1 AND otd.merchant_id = #{merchantBaseId} GROUP BY mg.merchant_goods_id, mg.goods_name, mg.price ORDER BY 销售数量 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT mg.merchant_goods_id as 商品ID, mg.goods_name as 商品名称, COALESCE(mg.price, 0) as 商品价格, COALESCE(SUM(otd.quantity), 0) as 销售数量, @rank := @rank + 1 as 排名 FROM merchant_goods mg LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail otd ON mg.merchant_goods_id = otd.goods_id LEFT JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id AND om.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND om.pay_status = 1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0) r WHERE mg.merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} AND mg.status = 1 GROUP BY mg.merchant_goods_id, mg.goods_name, mg.price HAVING 销售数量 <= 5 ORDER BY 销售数量 ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT content FROM merchant_evaluation WHERE rating >= 4 AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' AND merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT content FROM merchant_evaluation WHERE rating <= 2 AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' AND merchant_base_id = #{merchantBaseId} LIMIT #{limit}
